verdict.rationale: Polar is API-first: it publishes versioned OpenAPI specs and typed SDKs for automated, non-interactive calls, plus a fully isolated sandbox environment explicitly for scripted testing of full flows (checkout, subscriptions) without a UI, and webhooks for async event-driven automation. This directly supports headless/CI usage (e.g., calling billing operations from scripts/pipelines), though missing for 10: an explicit CLI tool, documented CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g., GitHub Actions integration), and independent hands-on confirmation of running Polar operations inside an actual CI job.
